functions.name: central_methylation_analysis
functions.description: Federated DMPs (inverse-variance meta-analysis of within-hospital cohort comparisons) and DMRs

arguments.name: cohort_a
arguments.description: Cohort label (value of the cohort column) used as reference.

arguments.name: cohort_b
arguments.description: Cohort label compared with the reference; estimates are cohort_b - cohort_a.

arguments.name: cohort_column
arguments.description: Column in each node's data that holds the cohort of each sample.

arguments.name: use_m_values
arguments.description: Fit the per-probe models on M-values (default) or beta values.

arguments.name: min_samples
arguments.description: Minimum patients of each cohort a hospital needs to take part (at least 2, default 2). Hospitals share per-probe means and standard errors per cohort; larger values protect patients better.

arguments.name: dmr_max_gap
arguments.description: Maximum distance between neighbouring probes of a DMR.

arguments.name: dmr_fdr
arguments.description: Probe adj_p_value threshold for probes in a DMR.

arguments.name: dmr_min_probes
arguments.description: Minimum number of probes in a DMR.

arguments.name: moderate_variance
arguments.description: Moderate each hospital's per-probe variances with limma's empirical Bayes method (recommended with small cohorts).

arguments.name: top_n
arguments.description: DMPs with the smallest p-value to return, 1 to 10,000. All probes are still tested and corrected for multiple testing.
